[[Hanaku's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Focus of Hanaku]], a [[foe]] who can be found in [[Rhea's Crater]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves casting time of Domination Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of Domination Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
Including appearance¹, exact technical replica for this item is the [[Inscribed Chakram]] from collectors [[Axton]], [[Claw Tallfeather]], [[Goran Grimyak]], or [[Rylan Paval]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


It is possible to create an exact replica¹ for this item with:
*[[Inscribed Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription#Forget Me Not|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
*[[Dye|Black dye]]

¹ Chakrams from some of the above sources can not be dyed


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]

**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
